title: Patient Terms: No-Show History and Extension Visits on Referrals
content:
When an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is extended, the no-show trim of the extension visits follows the no-show fees assessed on the patient's In-Person Appointments in the 12 months before the handling date. A fee later waived still counts as assessed.

| No-show fees assessed in those 12 months | No-show trim |
|---|---|
| two or more | two visits taken away |
| exactly one | one visit taken away |
| none | nothing taken away |

The fees counted are those assessed on any of the patient's In-Person Appointments, dated within the 12 months before the handling date, waived or not. Late-cancellation fees are not no-show fees and are not counted here.
